program.merge_policy: accumulate eight 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after 200

policy.validation_strategy: cheap duplicate/entity/source screening during authoring; expensive repository-wide validation only after Wave 700

waves.focus: 2024 network meta-analysis of cranberry formulations for UTI prevention; preserve juice/product form and comparator boundaries.
meta-analysis of cranberry proanthocyanidin exposure and UTI risk; composition threshold is study metadata, not a consumer dose recommendation.
updated randomized-trial meta-analysis of fenugreek seed for glycemic outcomes; fasting glucose signal with heterogeneity and HOMA-IR/null boundaries.
2025 skin-aging RCT meta-analysis; apparent hydration/elasticity/wrinkle benefits disappear in non-industry-funded and higher-quality subgroups, making funding/quality sensitivity first-class.

2026 RCT meta-analysis specific to vitamin D2 effects on parathyroid hormone, calcium, and phosphorus; D2-specific identity and mineral-homeostasis endpoints must remain separate from generic vitamin-D claims.
2026 umbrella review of randomized-trial meta-analyses for glycemic-control biomarkers; review-overlap and surrogate-outcome boundaries require exact extraction before claim promotion.
2026 updated systematic review/meta-analysis with trial-sequential analysis for irritable bowel syndrome; strain, symptom endpoint, and IBS-subtype heterogeneity must remain explicit.

2026 umbrella review spanning skin and musculoskeletal outcomes; favorable dermal/bone/muscle findings coexist with mixed oral-health/cardiometabolic results, and collagen preparation identity must not be flattened.

2026 systematic review/meta-analysis of alpha-lipoic acid as adjunctive therapy in schizophrenia; psychiatric population, adjunctive-treatment status, efficacy and safety require source-specific extraction.

2026 systematic review/meta-analysis of creatine and kidney health in healthy people and CKD; separate serum-creatinine interpretation from true renal-function outcomes and preserve CKD-vs-healthy populations.

2025 GRADE-assessed RCT meta-analysis of inflammatory/oxidative biomarkers; oxidative markers improved while CRP, IL-6 and TNF-alpha were largely null, so anti-inflammatory claims require calibration.
33-RCT meta-analysis in older adults/chronic disease at risk of functional disability; modest physical-function signal with heterogeneity and population-specific boundary.
2025 GRADE-assessed dose-response RCT meta-analysis of blood pressure; preserve preparation, baseline-BP, duration and dose-response boundaries.
2026 systematic review/meta-analysis in healthy young men separating resistance-training from non-resistance-training contexts for lean mass, strength and performance.
2025 placebo-controlled RCT meta-analysis of cognition in healthy adults; some reaction-time domains improved while several cognitive tests were null, with few trials and preparation heterogeneity.

2026 randomized placebo-controlled systematic review/meta-analysis of testosterone-axis outcomes in adult men; preserve male population, extract identity, surrogate hormone outcomes and related safety context.
2025 RCT meta-analysis of depression and anxiety symptoms; depression effects varied by scale and anxiety was null in the limited pooled evidence.
2026 systematic review/meta-analysis in type 2 diabetes; disease-specific glycemic/lipid evidence only, not a generic diabetes-treatment claim.
2026 systematic review/meta-analysis found no clinically meaningful pooled glycemic or lipid benefit from olive-leaf extract/oleuropein in continuous-intake RCTs; strong null counterweight.
34-RCT GRADE-assessed glycemic meta-analysis; fasting glucose, insulin and HOMA-IR signals with HbA1c null and very high heterogeneity for several endpoints.
54-RCT GRADE-assessed inflammatory-marker meta-analysis; CRP and IL-6 signals with TNF-alpha null and high heterogeneity.
updated randomized-trial meta-analysis of anthropometric outcomes; preparation and baseline-population heterogeneity require source-specific interpretation.
randomized-trial meta-analysis in metabolic syndrome; disease-specific lipid and glycemic outcomes require exact extraction and should not be merged with general-population Nigella evidence.
34-study updated meta-analysis of adult lipid outcomes; pooled TC/TG/LDL reductions and HDL increase with substantial preparation and population heterogeneity.
30-RCT updated glycemic meta-analysis; fasting glucose and HbA1c signals coexist with insulin and HOMA-IR nulls and extremely high heterogeneity.
